agents.description: Full profile of a US prescription drug by brand or generic name: identity and manufacturer, live CMS NADAC acquisition pricing, Medicare Part D spending and utilization, estimated pricing spread, and active clinical-trial pipeline. Broader than drug_price_lookup — use when someone wants the whole picture of a drug.

assessment.explanation: I found two tools that can help you look up drug information. The `health_drug_lookup` tool can provide details like active ingredients, purpose, indications, warnings, dosage, and manufacturer from FDA drug labels. The `drug_info_lookup` tool offers a broader profile of a US prescription drug, including identity and manufacturer information.
